Require hardware breakpoints globally before connection plus explicit -H. Resource exhaustion is failure, no automatic software fallback. Internal loader stops also need review.
fromSurface successful path tail-calls; return capture must use saved original x30 and original TID/SP/call token. A static3be0 return probe observes NULL path.

A Python subprocess timeout/kill of LLDB is not cleanup. Independent owner must retain session/server identity and detach state; verify TracerPid0 and no debugger-stop, parent unchanged. If child has exited record exact exit evidence, not fabricated resume.
Do not run SDK lldb_python.main: serial-less hdc auto-install/start; use outer serial-qualified transport and only session-owned forwarding/server.
